title: The Courage to Forgive, or Not

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE V: FAMILY DRAMA, FEUDS AND LEADERSHIP DISPUTES (LCE-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
All sorts of real-life drama suited to Isola: parents with opinions about who their children marry, arranged matches, inheritances, feuds between families, accusations, apologies that are not enough, and arguments about who should lead.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A neighbor who once betrayed a villager's trust asks to be forgiven: forgive them, or not yet.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Years ago, (friend) told the whole village a secret (subject) had trusted (friend.him/her) with, and (subject) has never forgotten it. Now (friend) has come to (subject)'s door and asked to be forgiven. (friend.He/she) seems to mean it. Some of the village think (subject) should forgive and move on. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) says (subject.he/she) forgives (friend.him/her). It is true, and it is also not the end: (subject) does not tell (friend) secrets anymore, and maybe never will. But they can sit at the same fire.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) says (subject.he/she) is not ready, and may never be. (friend) nods, and leaves. The village is not all happy about it. But (subject) knows (subject.his/her) own heart, and that is enough. (friend) keeps being kind from a distance.
